def moveBy(x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, down: true, up: true) send("G91 G0 Z#{$options.z}") if up send("G91 G0 X#{x} Y#{y} Z#{z}") send("G0 Z#{-$options.z}") if down send("G90") end
def wait # wait for all moves to finish send('M400') end
